{{Top|leg}}
The '''Copper Coast''', as it was known, was the eastern edge of the [[Meirm Sea]], located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]]. Its name came from the [[Copper/Legends|copper]] particles present in its sand which, when combined with the fog from the Meirm Sea, created a corrosion-green film in nearby [[Meirm City]].

The [[Boneglass Canyon]] connected its northern edge with the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Dnalvec]], twenty five [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] away.
